items.title: Edmond Hall Interview, 1958-07-18
items.q: So I, this guy, he's a, what's his name, Old Man Selma, but his son got the factory.

ctx.x: Yeah. Some of my friends, they all, the clarinetists we like, they all play Albert system, so it looks like they must be better. It's about everything.

I'll tell you another story. I went to Old Man Selma when I bought that instrument. And a lot of people come up and ask me, they say, well, why you play Albert system? I say, well, when I started playing, it wasn't making no BEM system. You say, well, how long they been making BEM system? I say, well, I remember seeing my first BEM run about, about 30 years ago. So when they'd asked me how long BEM was made, I say, oh, about 30 years ago. So what happens when I go to this factory, so I'm buying a, buying a Selma…
Yes. Yeah, that was in Paris.
